title: Page 5
content_zh:
路挽风在一旁默默望着坐在一块石头上的寒招财，见她俐落的用山泉将脚底洗净，再在布满水泡的脚底敷上适才摘来后捣烂的药草，最后再取过两片如脚底大小的肥厚叶片，用藤蔓牢牢捆在脚底。

处理完这些，寒招财站起来，朝他露齿一笑道：“好了，咱们走吧。”这身子真是没用，才走小半天，脚底就磨出水泡来。

他犹豫一瞬，朝她微蹲下身子，说道：“上来。”脚底伤成那样，她先前竟是一声都不吭，让他有些佩服她。

“做什么？”她一愣。

“你脚底都起了水泡，我背你一程。”

她轻笑了声，“你这是为了报答我的救命之恩？”

“不是。这不过是举手之劳，岂能与娄姑娘的救命之恩相比。”

“那是为什么？”她好奇一问。

“我们既然结伴同行，便该互相扶助，你先前不也教了我怎么分辨莲雾？”

“可咱们男女授受不亲。”她倒是想让他背，能轻松些，可不得不顾虑到彼此的身分。

“和尚都能背不敢涉水的妇人过河，如今你脚上有伤，我背你一程，也是基于道义。”他一脸严肃。

觉得他这话说得十分有理，寒招财不再顾忌，爬上他的背，他轻托着她的臀站起身，步履沉稳的往山下走去。

她两只手轻轻圈着他的颈子，除了家人，她第一次同男人如此亲近，也不知是不是日头太烈，晒得她的脸开始发烫起来，胸口好像有只野兔在乱闯，心音怦咚怦咚的有些乱了序。

陡然间瞥见他两只耳朵红通通的，发现不是只有自个儿在害臊，他也一样，她唇瓣漾开笑，故意问他，“欸，你是第一次背姑娘吗？”

“嗯。”他低应了声。

“背姑娘的感觉怎么样？”

“没怎么样。”

“可是你的耳朵都红了。”

“太热了。”

她隐隐察觉到他被她问得身子微微一僵，笑盈盈接着再问：“那我会不会很重？”

“不会。”

听出他语气已微微流露出不耐烦，她笑咪咪说道：“你要是累的话，就放我下来，我能自己走。”她这是以退为进，实际上她还想再在他背上偷懒一会儿。

“我还不累。”

听他如她所愿说出这句话，寒招财心情极好的说：“那我说个故事给你听。”也不等他开口说要不要听，她就自顾自讲下去，“从前山上住着一只白虎精，他瞧上了一头野猪精，但野猪精看上的却是一条青蛇妖，没想到那青蛇妖中意的竟是一只蜘蛛精，蜘蛛精却迷恋上一只蝶妖，谁知那蝶妖则对一只黄鼠狠一见钟情……”

听到这里，路挽风终于忍不住出声，“你这故事怎么没完没了，就没有两情相悦的吗，全都是一厢情愿？”

“原来你有认真在听我说故事啊。”她笑咪咪道。

发现自己被她作弄了，路挽风抿着唇不再出声。

“其实也不是没有两情相悦的，故事我还没说完呢。”她带着笑意的嗓音回荡在静谧的山林间，“后来黄鼠狼遇见一只耗子精，两只妖怪为了争夺一只猫妖打起来，耗子打跑黄鼠狼，最后赢得猫妖的芳心，两只妖怪就拜天地洞房啦。”

她的气息拂在他颈后，柔嫩的双手环在他颈子上，耳畔传来她那脆亮的嗓音，先前因沦落在荒野之间而产生的隐隐焦躁彷佛被抚去了，取而代之的是一种陌生的情愫，路挽风的步伐不禁渐渐放慢了几分。

日落时分，终于瞧见不远处有袅袅炊烟，有炊烟就表示那里有人家，寒招财与路挽风相觑一眼，脸上都露出一抹欣喜之色，加快脚步朝那里走去。

寒招财也顾不得脚疼，比他还快两步来到那户人家前，抬手敲了门。

“有人在吗？”

片刻后，里面传来回应，“是谁啊？”

“我和兄长在山里迷了路，想来问问下山的路怎么走？”寒招财盘算着，待会问好路，再想办法在这里留宿一夜，明天一早再下山。

须臾，木门咿呀张艳媚的脸庞，忍不住为之惊艳，下一瞬想到什么，面露惊疑之色，脱口道：“你是人是鬼？”

在这荒凉的山上，突然出现这般美貌的女子，不得不令他起疑，他住在山上两年多，虽不曾见过什么精怪，可以前也没少听说那些鬼怪的传说。

被他这般怀疑，寒招财好笑的回答，“老丈，您看清楚，我是人，活生生的人，您瞧我有影子的。”她指着映在地上的身影。

后头的路挽风上前一步拦在她面前，出声问道：“老丈，我们想下山去苏云城，请问该走哪条路？”

老丈打量两人几眼，疑惑的问：“你们要去苏云城，怎么会跑到这儿来？”

寒招财在后头搭腔，“我们先前搭的客船在淮江翻覆了，我们是从岸边那儿一路走过来的。”

老丈闻言惊讶道：“这好端端的船怎么会翻了？”

“昨儿个忽然下起一场雷暴雨，那雨来得又急又猛，还有落雷击中咱们的船，那船就被雷击沉了，我和兄长死里逃生，好不容易才游到岸边，这才捡回一条命。”事实上寒招财对客船是怎么倾覆的压根就不清楚，只是随口瞎说了几句，好取信于这老丈。

老丈纳闷的道：“可咱们这儿没下雨啊。”

“大雨八成都下到江上去了，您不知道昨天那雨就宛如天上破了个大洞，一桶一桶的往下倒，还有那电闪雷鸣，简直就像是天要塌了，还有哪，那江里就像有好几条蛟龙在斗法，把整条江给搅得天翻地覆，可吓死人了！”加油添醋的说完，寒招财还拍了拍胸脯，露出一脸余悸犹存的惊恐表情。

老丈听见她的话，想像着那光景，也皱起眉头，黑瘦的脸上少了分防备之色，多了分同情，“那么可怕，你们也算是命大。”

“可不是，也不知船上的人能逃出来几个。”她深深叹了口气，把话题绕了回去，“老丈，咱们原本是要去苏云城，这会儿船翻了，只能走陆路过去，您可知道这路要怎么走？”

老丈指着一条山径说道：“你们下山后就会看到白丰镇，从白丰镇前往绥城，绥城那儿就有驿车往返苏云城。”

“那从这儿下山约莫要多久？”

“脚程快的话差不多要一、两个时辰，这会儿天色也不早了，要不你们就在我这儿歇一夜，明儿个一早再下山。”老丈已信了寒招财所说的那些话，好心说道。

“那就多谢老丈了。”见不仅问到路，还能在这里过夜，寒招财笑盈盈推开挡在她身前的路挽风，热络的说着，“您这会儿是在做晚饭吗，要不要我帮忙？”她想趁机捞顿饭吃，从昨夜到方才吃的都是山果，她很想吃顿热腾腾的饭菜。

“我这儿也没什么好招待的，只摘了些野菜和笋子，配些粗粮吃。”

“我认得不少野菜，我再去替您摘些回来，我从那边过来时，还瞧见不少能吃的野菇，我顺道摘些。”说完，寒招财兴匆匆的往回走。

第2章(2)

路挽风若有所思的瞥她一眼，接着朝那老丈微微颔首，跟着她过去，瞧见她沿着山径，俐落的摘了不少野菜野菇。

他第一回见到娄竹心与这两日所见，性子竟是大相迳庭，宛若两人，尤其她知道不少他都不知道的事。这一路走来，她不仅能找到哪里有山泉可饮，还会分辨能食用的山果，且尽管走得脚底都起泡，她也没抱怨一句，还知道自己采来药草敷在脚底，再在脚下绑上肥厚的叶片，充当鞋垫。
content_en:
Lu Wanfeng silently watched Han Zhaocai sitting on a rock, and saw her neatly washing the soles of her feet with mountain springs, and then applying the picked and mashed herbs to the blistered soles. Finally, she took two thick leaves as big as the soles of her feet and tied them tightly with vines.

After taking care of this, Han Zhaocai stood up, gave him a toothy smile and said, "Okay, let's go." This body was really useless. After walking for only half a day, blisters appeared on the soles of his feet.

He hesitated for a moment, squatted slightly towards her, and said, "Come up." The sole of her foot was so injured, but she didn't say a word before, which made him somewhat admire her.

"What to do?" She was stunned.

"You have blisters on the soles of your feet. I'll give you a ride."

She chuckled softly, "Are you doing this to repay me for saving your life?"

"No. This is just a small effort, how can it be compared with Miss Lou's life-saving grace."

"Why is that?" she asked curiously.

"Since we are traveling together, we should help each other. Didn't you teach me how to distinguish lotus mist before?"

"But we men and women are not intimate." She wanted him to carry it, which would make it easier, but she had to worry about each other's identities.

"A monk can carry a woman across a river who dares not to wade. Now that you have an injury on your foot, I am carrying you for a ride out of morality." He looked serious.

Feeling that what he said was very reasonable, Han Zhaocai no longer had any scruples and climbed onto his back. He gently held her hips to stand up and walked steadily down the mountain.

She gently circled his neck with both hands. Apart from her family, this was the first time she was so close to a man. Maybe it was because the sun was too strong, but her face began to heat up. Her chest felt like a hare was scurrying around, and her heartbeat was pounding out of order.

Suddenly she caught a glimpse of his two ears that were bright red, and realized that she was not the only one who was ashamed, but he was too. With a smile on her lips, she deliberately asked him, "Hey, is this your first time carrying a girl on your back?"

"Yeah." He whispered.

"How does it feel to carry a girl on your back?"

"Nothing."

"But your ears are red."

"It's too hot."

She faintly noticed that he stiffened slightly when she asked him, and then asked with a smile: "Then will I be very heavy?"

"No."

Hearing the hint of impatience in his tone, she smiled and said, "If you're tired, just put me down and I can walk by myself." She was retreating in order to advance. In fact, she wanted to laze on his back for a while longer.

"I'm not tired yet."

Hearing him say this as she wished, Han Zhaocai said in a very good mood: "Then let me tell you a story." Without waiting for him to say whether she wanted to hear it, she continued on by herself, "Once upon a time, there lived a white tiger spirit on the mountain. He took a fancy to it.I fell in love with a wild boar spirit, but what the wild boar spirit fell in love with was a green snake spirit. Unexpectedly, the green snake spirit fell in love with a spider spirit, and the spider spirit fell in love with a butterfly spirit. Unexpectedly, the butterfly spirit fell in love with a yellow mouse at first sight..."

Hearing this, Lu Wanfeng finally couldn't help but say, "Why is your story so endless? Isn't it about mutual love? Is it all wishful thinking?"

"So you are listening to my story seriously." She said with a smile.

Realizing that he had been tricked by her, Lu Wanfeng pursed his lips and stopped making any sound.

"Actually, it's not that there is no mutual love. I haven't finished the story yet." Her voice with a smile echoed in the quiet mountain forest. "Then the weasel met a mouse spirit, and the two monsters fought over a cat monster. The mouse beat the weasel away, and finally won the heart of the cat monster, and the two monsters worshiped the bridal chamber of heaven and earth."

Her breath caressed the back of his neck, her soft hands were wrapped around his neck, and her crisp voice came to his ears. The faint anxiety caused by being trapped in the wilderness seemed to have been stroked away, replaced by a strange feeling. Lu Wanfeng couldn't help but gradually slow down his pace.

At sunset, I finally saw the smoke from a cooking stove not far away. The smoke from the cooking stove meant that there was a home there. Han Zhaocai and Lu Wanfeng looked at each other, with a look of joy on their faces, and walked towards there faster.

Han Zhaocai didn't care about the pain in his feet. He arrived at the house two steps faster than him and raised his hand to knock on the door.

"Is anyone here?"

After a moment, a response came from inside, "Who is it?"

"My brother and I got lost in the mountains, and we wanted to ask how to go down the mountain?" Han Zhaocai planned to ask for the way later, and then find a way to stay here overnight and go back down the mountain early tomorrow morning.

For a moment, the wooden door opened and Zhang Yanmei's face couldn't help but be amazed. What came to mind in the next moment, a look of surprise appeared on his face, and he blurted out: "Are you a human or a ghost?"

The sudden appearance of such a beautiful woman on this desolate mountain had to make him suspicious. He had lived on the mountain for more than two years. Although he had never seen any ghosts, he had heard many legends about them before.

Being so doubted by him, Han Zhaocai replied in a funny way, "My father-in-law, please see clearly that I am a human being, a living person. You see I have a shadow." She pointed to the figure reflected on the ground.

On the road behind, Wanfeng stepped forward and stopped in front of her, and asked aloud: "Old man, we want to go down the mountain to Suyuncheng. Which way should we take?"

The old man looked at the two of them and asked doubtfully: "You are going to Suyuncheng, why are you here?"

Han Zhaocai spoke from behind, "The passenger ship we took earlier capsized in the Huaijiang River. We walked all the way from the shore."

The old man was surprised when he heard this: "How could this perfectly good boat capsize?"

"Yesterday, there was a sudden thunderstorm. The rain came quickly and violently, and lightning struck our boat. The boat was sunk by lightning. My brother and I escaped from death and finally swam to the shore and saved our lives." In fact, Han Zhaocai had no idea how the passenger boat capsized. He just said a few random words to win the trust of his father-in-law.

The old man said in confusion: "But it doesn't rain here."

"The heavy rain has almost reached the river. You don't know that the rain yesterday was like a big hole in the sky, pouring down bucket after bucket. There were also lightning and thunder, it was like the sky was about to collapse. What else, thatIt's like there are several dragons fighting in the river, turning the whole river upside down.It's scary!" After saying this in a jealous tone, Han Zhaocai patted his chest, showing an expression of lingering fear.

When the old man heard her words, he imagined the scene and frowned. His dark and thin face became less defensive and more sympathetic, "It's so scary, but you are lucky."

"No, I don't know how many people on the boat can escape." She sighed deeply and changed the topic, "Old man, we were originally going to Suyun City. Now the boat capsized and we can only go overland. Do you know how to get there?"

The old man pointed to a mountain path and said: "After you go down the mountain, you will see Baifeng Town. From Baifeng Town to Suicheng, there is a post train from Suicheng to Suyun City."

"How long does it take to go down the mountain from here?"

"If you walk quickly, it will take about an hour or two. It's getting dark now. Why don't you rest here for the night and go back down the mountain early tomorrow morning." The old man believed what Han Zhaocai said and said kindly.

"Thank you so much, father-in-law." Seeing that she not only asked for directions, but could also spend the night here, Han Zhaocai pushed the road in front of her with a smile and said warmly, "Are you making dinner right now? Do you want my help?" She wanted to take the opportunity to get a meal. All she had eaten since last night was nuts, and she wanted to have a hot meal.

"I don't have anything to entertain here. I just picked some wild vegetables and bamboo shoots to eat with some whole grains."

"I recognize a lot of wild vegetables. I'll pick some for you. When I came over there, I saw a lot of edible wild mushrooms. I'll pick some along the way." After saying that, Han Zhaocai walked back in a hurry.

Chapter 2(2)

Lu Wanfeng glanced at her thoughtfully, then nodded slightly to the old man, followed her, and saw her neatly picking a lot of wild vegetables and mushrooms along the mountain path.

The first time he saw Lou Zhuxin and the one he had seen these two days, their temperaments were completely different, just like two people, especially she knew a lot of things that he didn't know.Along the way, she could not only find where there were mountain springs to drink from, but also identify edible mountain fruits. Even though the soles of her feet were blistered, she did not complain. She also knew that she had picked herbs and applied them to the soles of her feet, and then tied thick leaves under her feet to act as insoles.
